focus_areas: Geometric grounding of hooves on the gravel path
Fur texture realism and edge definition against background
Anatomical correctness of the shoulder hump and head proportions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy forequarter fur and the smoother hindquarter fur. AI models often fail to render this textural gradient naturally, resulting in abrupt cuts or smearing. Also, verify that the horn curvature and thickness are consistent with real bison anatomy, as AI tends to exaggerate or distort horn shapes. Crucially, inspect the contact point between the front left hoof and the gravel to ensure there is no 'floating' effect or depth map error where the foot merges with the ground texture.
image_description: A large, adult bison standing on a gravel path in a natural setting with trees and grass in the background. The bison is facing slightly to the right, showcasing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur, and characteristic head features. The front left leg and hoof are clearly visible planted on the ground.
